---

## 1. Clarifying the Scope

| Question | Why it matters |
|----------|----------------|
| **Which individuals are you researching?** | The more specific you can be (full name, birth year, notable positions, etc.), the easier it is to locate reliable public sources and avoid conflating records of people with similar names. |

| **Do you have any existing research or leads?** | If you already have some records, I can help you organize them or identify gaps. |
